name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
briefDescription: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) offers collateral-free loans of up to ₹20 lakh to small, non-farm businesses through banks, NBFCs and microfinance institutions.
descriptionMd:
Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is a central scheme that helps small businesses get credit they would otherwise struggle to access. It funds income-generating micro enterprises in the non-farm sector — manufacturing, trading, services and activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy and beekeeping — with loans of up to **₹20 lakh**.

The scheme is delivered through approved **Member Lending Institutions (MLIs)** rather than the government directly. These include:

- Public sector banks
- Private sector banks
- State cooperative banks
- Regional rural banks
- Microfinance institutions (MFIs)
- Non-Banking Finance Companies (NBFCs)
- Small Finance Banks (SFBs)
- Other financial intermediaries approved by MUDRA Ltd.

Interest rates are set by each lender in line with RBI guidelines. Many banks **waive the processing fee on Shishu loans** (up to ₹50,000). Note that MUDRA does not appoint any agents or middlemen — be wary of anyone claiming to arrange a Mudra loan for a fee.
benefitsMd:
Loans are grouped into four stages based on how much funding the business needs:

- **Shishu:** up to ₹50,000.
- **Kishore:** above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5 lakh.
- **Tarun:** above ₹5 lakh and up to ₹10 lakh.
- **Tarun Plus:** up to ₹20 lakh, for entrepreneurs who have already repaid a loan under the Tarun category.
eligibilityMd:
The following can apply for a Mudra loan:

- Individuals
- Proprietorship concerns
- Partnership firms
- Private limited companies
- Public companies
- Other legal business forms

A few conditions apply: you should **not be a defaulter** with any bank or financial institution and should have a satisfactory credit record. Individual borrowers may need the relevant skills or experience for the activity, and any educational-qualification requirement depends on the nature of the proposed business.
applicationMd:
Keep these ready before you start: ID proof, address proof, a passport-size photo, your signature, and proof of identity/address of the business.

**Step 1:** Visit the PM MUDRA site at [mudra.org.in](https://www.mudra.org.in), then go to the [Udyamimitra portal](https://udyamimitra.in/).
**Step 2:** Click **'Apply Now'** for a Mudra loan.
**Step 3:** Choose your category — new entrepreneur, existing entrepreneur, or self-employed professional.
**Step 4:** Enter your name, email and mobile number, and generate the OTP to register.

After registering:

**Step 5:** Fill in your personal and professional details.
**Step 6:** Select a hand-holding agency if you need help preparing the proposal; otherwise go straight to the loan application.
**Step 7:** Pick the loan category — Shishu, Kishore or Tarun.
**Step 8:** Add your business information (name, activity, industry type) and financial details (ownership, existing and proposed credit, estimates, preferred lender).
**Step 9:** Upload all required documents and submit. Note down the **application number** generated for future reference.
